stories.title: Implement runGit chokepoint with env/stdio/timeout contract
stories.description: Add classifyGitCommand, buildEnv, GitTimeoutError, and runGit to src/modules/git.ts per architecture D1-D5. Refactor inspectGitRepository and countUncommittedChanges to call runGit internally with unchanged public signatures.
acceptanceCriteria: runGit closes stdin on every invocation (D5)
runGit sets GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, GCM_INTERACTIVE=Never, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 on every invocation (D2)
runGit applies a command-class timeout, overridable via options (D3/D4)
A timed-out invocation rejects with GitTimeoutError, not a generic Error
inspectGitRepository and countUncommittedChanges keep identical exported signatures and return shapes
stories.testEvidence: test/git.test.ts unmodified, 3/3 passing (R5). Full suite 469/470 passing (1 skipped, unrelated). Coverage src/modules/git.ts: 98.05% line / 90.24% branch. Revised post-review: classifyGitCommand is now three-tier (explicit read/write/network) with a write-biased fallback for unrecognized subcommands, correctly skips -c/-C separate-token values, killSignal changed to SIGTERM, timeout lookup has a defensive fallback, GitTimeoutError doc corrected to not overclaim.

stories.title: Regression coverage for the execution contract
stories.description: Add test/git-execution-contract.test.ts covering R1-R4 from the PRD plus the EF-13 optional-locks regression, using test/helpers/git-fixture.ts for real-repo fixtures. Confirm test/git.test.ts still passes unmodified.
acceptanceCriteria: git credential fill against a fixture settles within a short bound instead of hanging (R3)
runGit with an artificially small timeoutMs throws GitTimeoutError (R4)
a real commit still succeeds with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 in effect (R2)
coverage on src/modules/git.ts meets the 80% line / repo-standard threshold
stories.testEvidence: test/git-execution-contract.test.ts (12) + test/git-timeout-mapping.test.ts (7, mocked) covering R1-R4. Two follow-up fixes after the two review passes: (1) the original EF-13 optional-locks test used a Windows chmod fixture that review proved vacuous (chmod-444 on a Windows directory doesn't block file creation inside it) -- removed, replaced with an honest scope disclosure; follow-up task filed for a real restricted-filesystem harness. (2) CI (Linux) caught that the timeout tests raced a real `git status` against a 1ms timeout -- legitimately fast enough to complete in under 1ms on that runner, an environment-dependent flake, not a bug. Replaced with test/git-timeout-mapping.test.ts, which mocks node:child_process to deterministically test runGit's own error-mapping and timeout-value-selection logic without depending on real process speed. Full suite 474/475 passing (1 unrelated skip), lint clean, typecheck clean. Coverage src/modules/git.ts: 98.05% line / 90% branch, now stable between isolated and full-suite runs.
